#[pymethods]
impl QuantumTrader {
    #[new]
    fn new(keypair_path: &str, priority_fee: Option<u64>) -> PyResult<Self> {
        let keypair_data = std::fs::read_to_string(keypair_path)
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Failed to read keypair: {}", e)))?;
        
        let keypair_bytes: Vec<u8> = serde_json::from_str(&keypair_data)
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Invalid keypair JSON: {}", e)))?;
        
        let keypair = Keypair::from_bytes(&keypair_bytes)
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Invalid keypair data: {}", e)))?;

        info!("🔑 Loaded keypair: {}", keypair.pubkey());

        Ok(Self {
            client: Arc::new(RpcClient::new_with_commitment(
                HELIUS_RPC,
                CommitmentConfig::confirmed(),
            )),
            keypair: Arc::new(keypair),
            http_client: Arc::new(Client::builder()
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
                .build()
                .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("HTTP client error: {}", e)))?),
            priority_fee: priority_fee.unwrap_or(15000),
        })
    }

    #[pyo3(text_signature = "($self, token_mint, amount, is_buy, priority_fee=None)")]
    fn execute_swap(
        &self,
        token_mint: &str,
        amount: f64,
        is_buy: bool,
        priority_fee: Option<u64>,
    ) -> PyResult<String> {
        let priority_fee = priority_fee.unwrap_or(self.priority_fee);
        let start = Instant::now();
        
        info!("💫 Trading {} SOL {} {}", 
            amount, 
            if is_buy { "→" } else { "←" },
            token_mint
        );

        // Get Jupiter quote
        let (input_mint, output_mint) = if is_buy {
            (SOL_MINT, token_mint)
        } else {
            (token_mint, SOL_MINT)
        };

        let lamports = (amount * 1e9) as u64;
        let quote_url = format!(
            "{}/quote?inputMint={}&outputMint={}&amount={}&slippageBps=50&onlyDirectRoutes=true&wrapUnwrapSOL=true",
            JUPITER_API, input_mint, output_mint, lamports,
        );

        info!("🚀 Getting quote...");
        let quote_start = Instant::now();
        
        let quote_response = self.http_client
            .get(&quote_url)
            .send()
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Quote request failed: {}", e)))?;

        let mut quote: Value = quote_response
            .json()
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Quote parse failed: {}", e)))?;
            
        // Ensure price is numeric
        if let Some(price) = quote.get("price") {
            let price_num = price.as_str()
                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<f64>().ok())
                .or_else(|| price.as_f64())
                .unwrap_or(0.0);
            
            if let Some(obj) = quote.as_object_mut() {
                obj.insert("price".to_string(), json!(price_num));
            }
        }
            
        info!("⚡ Quote fetched in: {:?}", quote_start.elapsed());
        
        // Build swap transaction
        info!("🔄 Building atomic swap transaction...");
        let swap_start = Instant::now();
        
        let swap_request = json!({
            "quoteResponse": quote,
            "userPublicKey": self.keypair.pubkey().to_string(),
            "wrapUnwrapSOL": true,
            "computeUnitPriceMicroLamports": priority_fee,
            "priorityFee": priority_fee,
            "maxAccounts": 64,
            "asLegacyTransaction": false
        });

        let swap_response = self.http_client
            .post(format!("{}/swap", JUPITER_API))
            .json(&swap_request)
            .send()
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Swap request failed: {}", e)))?;

        let swap_data: Value = swap_response
            .json()
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Swap parse failed: {}", e)))?;
            
        info!("⚡ Swap built in: {:?}", swap_start.elapsed());

        let tx_data = swap_data["swapTransaction"].as_str()
            .ok_or_else(|| PyValueError::new_err("No transaction data in response"))?;

        // Send with priority and skipPreflight
        info!("💨 Sending priority transaction...");
        let tx_start = Instant::now();
        
        let request = json!({
            "jsonrpc": "2.0",
            "id": "quantum-trade",
            "method": "sendTransaction",
            "params": [
                tx_data,
                {
                    "encoding": "base64",
                    "maxRetries": 0,
                    "skipPreflight": true,
                    "preflightCommitment": "processed",
                    "priorityFee": priority_fee
                }
            ]
        });

        let response = self.http_client
            .post(HELIUS_RPC)
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer 1ea5843b-9daa-4926-a97a-be021922da2f")
            .json(&request)
            .send()
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Failed to send: {}", e)))?;

        let result: Value = response
            .json()
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Failed to parse response: {}", e)))?;
            
        info!("⚡ Transaction sent in: {:?}", tx_start.elapsed());
        info!("✨ Total execution time: {:?}", start.elapsed());

        match result.get("result") {
            Some(signature) => Ok(signature.as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string()),
            None => {
                if let Some(error) = result.get("error") {
                    Err(PyValueError::new_err(format!("Helius error: {:?}", error)))
                } else {
                    Err(PyValueError::new_err("Unexpected response format"))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[pyo3(text_signature = "($self)")]
    fn get_sol_balance(&self) -> PyResult<f64> {
        let balance = self.client
            .get_balance(&self.keypair.pubkey())
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Failed to get balance: {}", e)))?;
        
        let balance_sol = balance as f64 / 1e9;
        info!("SOL balance retrieved: {}", balance_sol);
        Ok(balance_sol)
    }

    #[pyo3(text_signature = "($self, signature)")]
    fn verify_transaction(&self, signature: &str) -> PyResult<bool> {
        let status = self.client
            .get_signature_status(&signature.parse()
                .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Invalid signature: {}", e)))?)
            .map_err(|e| PyValueError::new_err(format!("Failed to get status: {}", e)))?;

        let verified = status.is_some() && status.unwrap().is_ok();
        info!("Transaction verification for signature {}: {}", signature, verified);
        Ok(verified)
    }

    #[pyo3(text_signature = "($self, new_fee)")]
    fn set_priority_fee(&mut self, new_fee: u64) {
        self.priority_fee = new_fee;
        info!("Priority fee set to: {}", new_fee);
    }

    #[pyo3(text_signature = "($self)")]
    fn get_wallet_address(&self) -> String {
        let address = self.keypair.pubkey().to_string();
        info!("Wallet address retrieved: {}", address);
        address
    }

import time
import os
import csv
import pandas as pd
import requests
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright


# Constants for captcha solving
API_KEY = "9169f493fd83428f21cea548ec9cf42f" # Replace with your 2Captcha API key
MAX_RETRIES = 5 # Maximum retries for solving CAPTCHA


def solve_captcha_with_2captcha(captcha_image_path):
"""
Use 2Captcha API to solve CAPTCHA.
"""
print("Submitting CAPTCHA to 2Captcha...")
captcha_data = {
"method": "post",
"key": API_KEY,
"header_acept": "application/json", # JSON response format
}

# Send the CAPTCHA to 2Captcha
with open(captcha_image_path, "rb") as captcha_file:
response = requests.post("https://2captcha.com/in.php", files={"file": captcha_file}, data=captcha_data)

if response.ok and "OK|" in response.text:
captcha_id = response.text.split("|")[1]
print(f"CAPTCHA submitted successfully, ID: {captcha_id}")
else:
print("Failed to send CAPTCHA to 2Captcha:", response.text)
return None

# Retrieve the CAPTCHA solution
solution_url = f"http://2captcha.com/res.php?key={API_KEY}&action=get&id={captcha_id}"
for _ in range(10): # Retry every 5 seconds for up to 50 seconds
res_response = requests.get(solution_url)
if "OK|" in res_response.text:
captcha_solution = res_response.text.split('|')[1]
print(f"CAPTCHA solved: {captcha_solution}")
return captcha_solution
elif "CAPCHA_NOT_READY" in res_response.text:
time.sleep(5) # Wait 5 seconds before retrying
else:
print("Error while retrieving CAPTCHA solution:", res_response.text)
break

print("Failed to solve CAPTCHA via 2Captcha.")
return None


def scrape_patent_data(patent_number):
"""
Scrape patent data for a single patent number.
"""
with sync_playwright() as p:
browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=False)
page = browser.new_page()

try:
# Visit website and retry in case of failure
retries = 0
while retries < MAX_RETRIES:
try:
page.goto("https://iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in/PublicSearch/PublicationSearch/Eregister",
wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
print("Page loaded successfully.")
break
except Exception as e:
print(f"Failed to load page, retrying ({retries + 1}/{MAX_RETRIES})...")
retries += 1
if retries >= MAX_RETRIES:
print("Max retries for page load reached. Skipping patent number...")
return None

# Fill Patent Number
page.wait_for_selector('input[name="PatentNumber"]', timeout=60000)
page.fill('input[name="PatentNumber"]', patent_number)

# Wait for CAPTCHA to load and save the CAPTCHA image
page.wait_for_selector('#Captcha', timeout=60000)
captcha_element = page.locator('#Captcha')
captcha_path = f"captcha_{patent_number}.png"
captcha_element.screenshot(path=captcha_path)
print(f"CAPTCHA image saved as {captcha_path}.")

# Solve the CAPTCHA using 2Captcha
for captcha_attempts in range(MAX_RETRIES):
captcha_text = solve_captcha_with_2captcha(captcha_path)

if not captcha_text:
print(f"Retrying CAPTCHA solving... ({captcha_attempts + 1}/{MAX_RETRIES})")
continue

# Fill the CAPTCHA and click submit
page.fill('input[name="CaptchaText"]', captcha_text)
page.click('input[name="submit"]')

# Wait to check if an invalid CAPTCHA prompt appears
time.sleep(5) # Small delay to let the page respond

if page.locator('.error-message:has-text("CAPTCHA is invalid")').count() > 0:
print("Invalid CAPTCHA, retrying...")
continue # Retry with a new CAPTCHA solution

# No invalid CAPTCHA message - exit loop
break
else:
print("Max CAPTCHA retries reached. Skipping patent number...")
return None

# Wait for the search results to load
page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=60000)

# Fetch Patent Details
legal_status = safe_extract_text(page.locator('tr:has-text("Legal Status :") td:nth-child(2)'))
expiry_text = page.locator('tr:has-text("Date of Expiry :") td:nth-child(2)')
renewal_text = page.locator('tr:has-text("Due Date of Next Renewal :") td:nth-child(2)')
if expiry_text.count() > 0:
date_type = "Date of Expiry"
date_value = safe_extract_text(expiry_text)
else:
date_type = "Due Date of Next Renewal"
date_value = safe_extract_text(renewal_text)

patent_number_text = safe_extract_text(page.locator('tr:has-text("Patent Number") td:nth-child(3)'), default=patent_number)
application_number = safe_extract_text(page.locator('tr:has-text("Application Number") td:nth-child(3)'), default="N/A")
grant_title = safe_extract_text(page.locator('tr:has-text("Grant Title") td:nth-child(3), tr:has-text("Grant Title") td[colspan="4"]'))
patentee_name = safe_extract_text(page.locator('table:has-text("Name of Patentee") tr:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(2)'))
patentee_type = safe_extract_text(page.locator('table:has-text("Name of Patentee") tr:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(3)'))

# Extract last valid renewal details
renewal_table = page.locator('table#renual tbody')
row_count = renewal_table.locator('tr').count()

last_renewal_year = "N/A"
last_renewal_amount = "N/A"
last_renewal_date = "N/A"

for i in range(row_count - 1, 0, -1): # Iterate from the last row
row = renewal_table.locator('tr').nth(i)
columns = row.locator('td')

if columns.count() >= 8:
year = safe_extract_text(columns.nth(0)).replace('<sup>th</sup>', 'th')
renewal_amount = safe_extract_text(columns.nth(5))
renewal_date = safe_extract_text(columns.nth(7))

if year and "--" not in (year, renewal_amount, renewal_date):
last_renewal_year = year
last_renewal_amount = renewal_amount
last_renewal_date = renewal_date
break

return {
'Legal Status': legal_status,
'Patent Number': patent_number_text,
'Application Number': application_number,
'Date Type': date_type,
'Date Value': date_value,
'Grant Title': grant_title,
'Patentee Name': patentee_name,
'Patentee Type': patentee_type,
'Last Renewal Year': last_renewal_year,
'Renewal Amount': last_renewal_amount,
'Date of Renewal': last_renewal_date,
}

except Exception as e:
print(f"Error during scraping for Patent {patent_number}:", e)
return None

finally:
if os.path.exists(captcha_path):
os.remove(captcha_path)
browser.close()


def safe_extract_text(locator, default='N/A'):
try:
return locator.inner_html().strip()
except Exception:
return default


def save_to_csv(data, filename):
if data:
file_exists = os.path.isfile(filename)
with open(filename, mode='a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as file:
writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=data.keys())
if not file_exists:
writer.writeheader()
writer.writerow(data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
input_file = r"C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\o1mini\sample.xlsx"
output_file = "patent_data2.csv"

print("Reading patent numbers from Excel file...")
df = pd.read_excel(input_file)

# Check for the column with patent numbers
if 'Patent No.' not in df.columns:
print("Column 'Patent Number' not found in Excel file.")
exit()

# Process each patent number
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
patent_number = str(row['Patent No.'])
print(f"Processing patent number: {patent_number}")

scraped_data = scrape_patent_data(patent_number)
if scraped_data:
print(f"Saving data for patent number {patent_number}...")
save_to_csv(scraped_data, output_file)
else:
print(f"Failed to scrape data for patent number {patent_number}. Skipping...")

def format_exec_block(block):
if not block:
return []

# Identify maximum length before '=' for alignment
max_length_before_equals = max(
(len(line.split('=')[0].strip()) for line in block if '=' in line),
default=0,
)

formatted_block = []

for line in block:
stripped_line = line.strip()
if '=' in stripped_line:
parts = stripped_line.split('=')
left_part = parts[0].rstrip().ljust(max_length_before_equals + 1)
right_part = '= ' + parts[1].strip()
# Preserve existing indentation
indent = line[:line.index(stripped_line)] # Get the existing leading spaces
formatted_line = indent + left_part + right_part
formatted_block.append(formatted_line)
else:
formatted_block.append(line) # Keep the existing line as is

return formatted_block

if inputDirection != Vector2.ZERO and timeBeforeCanSlideAgain <= 0 and lastFramePosition.y >= position.y: #character can slide only on flat or downhill surfaces

#change the start slide in air variable depending zon where the slide begun

#condition here, the state is changed only if the character is moving (so has an input direction)
if inputDirection != Vector2.ZERO and timeBeforeCanDashAgain <= 0:
currentState = states.DASH

dashTime = dashTimeRef
velocityPreDash = velocity #save the pre dash velocity, to apply it when the dash is finished (to get back to a normal velocity)

#condition here, the state is changed only if the character speed is greater than the walk speed
if velocity.length() > walkSpeed and currentState != states.DASH and currentState != states.CROUCH and canWallRun:
currentState = states.ONWALL
velocity.y *= wallGravityMultiplier #gravity value became onwall one

if nbJumpsInAirAllowed != nbJumpsInAirAllowedRef: nbJumpsInAirAllowed = nbJumpsInAirAllowedRef

standHitbox.disabled = false
crouchHitbox.disabled = true

if mesh.scale.y != 1.0:

#this function handle the collisions, but in this case, only the collision with a wall, to detect if the character can wallrun
if is_on_wall():
var lastCollision = get_slide_collision(0)

if lastCollision:
var collidedBody = lastCollision.get_collider()
var layer = collidedBody.collision_layer

#here, we check the layer of the collider, then we check if the layer 3 (walkableWall) is enabled, with 1 << 3-1. If theses two points are valid, the character can wallrun
if layer & (1 << 3-1) != 0: canWallRun = true
else: canWallRun = false

#if the character is moving

#apply slide move

velocity.z = moveDirection.z * dashSpeed

if collider != null and not collider.is_in_group("interactable"):
collider = null

# conver the global position to local position and move
# the hotspot out to the distance of the hit point to better
# predict what the player seems to intend to interact with
# **this could be a problem when attempting to interact around corners**
hotspot.transform.origin = to_local(hotspot_global_position)

if show_debug_shapes: # DEBUGGING
raycast_highlighter.global_position = hotspot_global_position
raycast_highlighter.visible = true
else:
# set the hotspot to the base position if not raycasting anything
hotspot.transform.origin = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, hotspot_base_pos_z)

if show_debug_shapes: # DEBUGGING
raycast_highlighter.transform.origin = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, hotspot_base_pos_z)
raycast_highlighter.visible = false


# if not raycasting a collider, then attempt a shapecast
if collider == null:
if shapecast.is_colliding():
# select the closest of all colliders detected by the shapecast
var closest_distance = INF
for i in range(shapecast.get_collision_count()):
var shape_collider = shapecast.get_collider(i)
if shape_collider != null and shape_collider.is_in_group("interactable"):
var collision_point = shapecast.get_collision_point(i)
#print("shapecast colliding with %s" % shape_collider)
var distance = collision_point.distance_squared_to(hotspot_global_position)
# always return the closest interactable to the hotspot's global position
if distance < closest_distance:
collider = shape_collider
closest_distance = distance

if show_debug_shapes: # DEBUGGING
target_highlighter.global_position = collision_point
target_highlighter.visible = true
else:
if show_debug_shapes: # DEBUGGING
target_highlighter.global_position = hotspot_global_position
target_highlighter.visible = true

if collider == _interactable:
return

# HACK: Turns out a null from the collider is/can be an object.
# This changes it to an actual null, so the freed object handling
# won't trigger on it.
if collider == null and typeof(collider) != 0:
collider = null

_interactable = collider

IDV Database archival solution

IMPLEMENTATION
1. Database partitioning
For each IDV table, create a backup table with identical schema. Will do for all 4 tables (idv_transaction, idv_ekyc_golden_source, idv_ekyc_golden_source_payload, idv_match_results)
eg:
CREATE TABLE idv_transaction ( // main table
...schema...
created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
) PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at);

CREATE TABLE idv_transaction_backup ( // backup table
...schema...
backup_created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

3. Tracker table
Create a centralized backup service tracking table. We are opting for a tracker table because we do not have any configuration management system like Zookeeper for a decentralised tracking.
CREATE idv_db_state (
last_backup TIMESTAMP,
last_purge TIMESTAMP,
last_success_update TIMESTAMP
);

2. Backup service
A service is implemented in spring (runs periodically) to execute backup using a ControlM job
- backup() - Inserts to backup_table for condition : WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days' | batch job | BATCH_SIZE | For all 4 tables
- purgeOldRecords() - Delete for condition : WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'
- validateBackup() - to validate is backup is successfull and update the DBState table.

BATCH SIZE
BATCH_SIZE is set as a 1000 (rows), and after testing we can incrementally increase it to 5000 or 10000 depending on resource utilisation and performance

1. creating partitions + creating tracket table
2. creating backup + purge + updating tracker table

Context solution for reference
IDV Database Archival Solution

IMPLEMENTATION
1. Database Partitioning
For each IDV table, create a backup table with identical schema. This will be done for all 4 tables:
idv_transaction, idv_ekyc_golden_source, idv_ekyc_golden_source_payload, idv_match_results

Example:
CREATE TABLE idv_transaction ( // main table
...schema...
created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
) PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at);

CREATE TABLE idv_transaction_backup ( // backup table
...schema...
backup_created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

2. Tracker Table
Create a centralized backup service tracking table. We are opting for a tracker table because we do not have any configuration management system like Zookeeper for decentralized tracking.
CREATE TABLE idv_db_state (
last_backup TIMESTAMP,
last_purge TIMESTAMP,
last_success_update TIMESTAMP
);

3. Backup Service
A service is implemented in Spring, which will be executed periodically through a Control-M job. The Backup Service will include the following methods:
- backup(): Inserts records into the backup table for the condition WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'. This will be a batch job based on the defined BATCH_SIZE.
- purgeOldRecords(): Deletes records from the main table for the condition WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'.
- validateBackup(): Validates backup success and updates the idv_db_state table.

4. Batch Processing
BATCH_SIZE is initially set to 1000 rows. After testing the impact on system performance, we can incrementally increase it to 5000 or 10000 rows, depending on resource utilization and observed performance.

5. Implementing as a Control-M Job
To integrate the Backup Service with Control-M, we will need to set up jobs that execute our Spring application. Here's how you can implement this:

Create a Control-M Job Definition:
Job Name: Specify a clear name for the job (e.g., IDV_Backup_Job).
Command: Set the command to run your Spring application or a specific JAR file. You can use a shell command to execute the desired operation:
java -jar your-application.jar backup
Parameters: If you have different tasks (e.g., backup and purge), set parameters to indicate which method to run when the job is executed. For example:

To run the backup: java -jar your-application.jar backup
To run the purge: java -jar your-application.jar purge

Scheduling Options:
Define the schedule for the job in Control-M (e.g., daily at 1 AM for backups, daily at 2 AM for purging) based on operational requirements.

import asyncio
import base64
import json
from typing import Dict, Optional, List, Set, Tuple
from decimal import Decimal
import time
import aiohttp
import websockets
import torch
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from collections import deque
import os
import logging
from solana_rust_bot import TradingCore, TradeParams
from solana_logger import SolanaLogger
from mempool_analyzer import EnhancedMempoolAnalyzer

logger = SolanaLogger(__name__)

@dataclass
class RateLimiter:
trades_per_second: int = int(os.getenv('MAX_TRADES_PER_SECOND', '2'))
trades_per_minute: int = int(os.getenv('MAX_TRADES_PER_MINUTE', '120'))
api_calls_per_minute: int = int(os.getenv('HELIUS_API_CALLS_PER_MINUTE', '150'))
last_trade: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
trade_count: int = 0
api_count: int = 0
last_reset: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

@dataclass
class TradeOpportunity:
pool_address: str
amount_in: Decimal
impact: Decimal
profit: Decimal
priority: int
timestamp: float
front_size: Decimal
back_size: Decimal
signature: str
confidence: float = 0.0

@dataclass
class ScalpState:
current_price: Decimal
bid_price: Decimal
ask_price: Decimal
buyer_volume: Decimal
seller_volume: Decimal
timestamp: float
side: Optional[str] = None # 'buy' or 'sell'

class HeliusWbSocketClient:
def __init__(self, trading_core: TradingCore, mempool_analyzer: EnhancedMempoolAnalyzer):
"""Initialize Helius client with enhanced monitoring and GPU acceleration"""
self.trading_core = trading_core
self.mempool_analyzer = mempool_analyzer
self.ws_helius = None
self.ws_quicknode = None
self.active = True
self.session = None
self.last_message_time = time.time()

# State
self.scalp_state = None
self.active_scalps = []
self.price_history = deque(maxlen=1000)

# Configuration
self._load_config()
self._load_scalp_config()

# Metrics tracking
self.metrics = {
'messages_processed': 0,
'opportunities_found': 0,
'trades_executed': 0,
'failed_trades': 0,
'api_calls': {'helius': 0, 'quicknode': 0},
'errors': {'ws': 0, 'parse': 0, 'execution': 0},
'latency': [],
'last_gc': time.time(),
'scalp_trades': 0,
'scalp_profit': Decimal('0'),
'mev_profit': Decimal('0')
}

# Setup
self._setup_gpu()
self.validated_pools: Set[str] = set()
self.rate_limiter = RateLimiter()
self.recent_opportunities = deque(maxlen=1000)
self.thread_pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)
logger.info("HeliusClient initialized successfully")

def _load_config(self):
"""Load configuration from environment"""
self.helius_url = os.getenv('HELIUS_WS_URL')
self.quicknode_url = os.getenv('QUICKNODE_WEBSOCKET')
self.raydium_program = os.getenv('RAYDIUM_PROGRAM_ID')
self.wsol_account = os.getenv('WSOL_TOKEN_ACCOUNT')
self.min_profit = float(os.getenv('MIN_PROFIT_PCT', '1.5')) / 100
self.max_impact = float(os.getenv('MAX_PRICE_IMPACT', '0.004'))
self.max_latency = float(os.getenv('MAX_LATENCY', '0.1'))

if not all([self.helius_url, self.quicknode_url, self.raydium_program, self.wsol_account]):
raise ValueError("Missing required environment variables")

def _load_scalp_config(self):
"""Load scalping configuration"""
self.SCALP_CONFIG = {
'min_profit_pct': float(os.getenv('MIN_PROFIT_PCT', '4.0'))/100,
'max_loss_pct': float(os.getenv('STOP_LOSS_PCT', '2.5'))/100,
'min_buyer_ratio': float(os.getenv('MIN_BUYER_RATIO', '0.45')),
'max_buyer_ratio': float(os.getenv('MAX_BUYER_RATIO', '0.65')),
'min_24h_volume': float(os.getenv('MIN_24H_VOLUME', '10000')),
'position_size': float(os.getenv('POSITION_SIZE', '0.1')),
'max_active_scalps': int(os.getenv('MAX_ACTIVE_TRADES', '4'))
}

def _setup_gpu(self):
"""Initialize GPU acceleration"""
if torch.cuda.is_available():
self.device = torch.device('cuda')
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True
torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True

self.streams = {
'compute': torch.cuda.Stream(),
'validation': torch.cuda.Stream(),
'execution': torch.cuda.Stream(),
'scalp': torch.cuda.Stream()
}

self.buffers = {
'price_history': torch.zeros((1000,), device=self.device, dtype=torch.float16),
'volume_history': torch.zeros((1000,), device=self.device, dtype=torch.float16),
'mempool': torch.zeros((128, 256), device=self.device, dtype=torch.float16)
}

logger.info("GPU acceleration enabled", extra={
'device': torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),
'memory': torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
})
else:
self.device = torch.device('cpu')
logger.warning("GPU not available, using CPU")

async def start(self):
"""Start websocket connections and monitoring"""
self.session = aiohttp.ClientSession()

tasks = [
self._process_helius_messages(),
self._process_quicknode_messages(),
self._monitor_connections(),
self._monitor_performance(),
self._monitor_active_scalps()
]

await asyncio.gather(*tasks)

async def _process_helius_messages(self):
"""Process messages from Helius websocket"""
retry_count = 0
while self.active:
try:
async with websockets.connect(self.helius_url, ping_interval=20, ping_timeout=5) as ws:
self.ws_helius = ws
await self._subscribe_helius()
retry_count = 0

async for msg in ws:
await self._handle_helius_message(msg)

except Exception as e:
retry_count += 1
await asyncio.sleep(min(30, 2 ** retry_count))

async def _process_quicknode_messages(self):
"""Process messages from QuickNode websocket"""
retry_count = 0
while self.active:
try:
async with websockets.connect(self.quicknode_url, ping_interval=20, ping_timeout=5) as ws:
self.ws_quicknode = ws
await self._subscribe_quicknode()
retry_count = 0

async for msg in ws:
await self._handle_quicknode_message(msg)

except Exception as e:
retry_count += 1
await asyncio.sleep(min(30, 2 ** retry_count))

async def _subscribe_helius(self):
"""Subscribe to Helius feeds"""
subscribe_msg = {
"jsonrpc": "2.0",
"id": 1,
"method": "logsSubscribe",
"params": [
{"mentions": [self.raydium_program]},
{"commitment": "processed"}
]
}
await self.ws_helius.send(json.dumps(subscribe_msg))

async def _subscribe_quicknode(self):
"""Subscribe to QuickNode feeds"""
# Market data subscription
market_sub = {
"jsonrpc": "2.0",
"id": 1,
"method": "subscribeMarketData",
"params": [
os.getenv('SOL_WSOL_MARKET'),
{"trades": True, "l2": True, "l3": False}
]
}
await self.ws_quicknode.send(json.dumps(market_sub))

# Mempool subscription
mempool_sub = {
"jsonrpc": "2.0",
"id": 2,
"method": "subscribeMempool"
}
await self.ws_quicknode.send(json.dumps(mempool_sub))

async def _handle_helius_message(self, msg: str):
"""Process Helius message"""
try:
data = json.loads(msg)
if "params" in data and "result" in data["params"]:
result = data["params"]["result"]
if "data" in result:
decoded = base64.b64decode(result["data"])
await self._process_mempool_data(decoded)

self.metrics['messages_processed'] += 1
self.metrics['api_calls']['helius'] += 1

except Exception as e:
self.metrics['errors']['parse'] += 1
logger.error(f"Helius message error: {e}")

async def _handle_quicknode_message(self, msg: str):
"""Process QuickNode message"""
try:
data = json.loads(msg)

# Handle market data updates
if "method" == "marketData" in data:
await self._handle_market_update(data["params"])

# Handle mempool updates
elif "method" == "mempoolTx" in data:
await self._handle_mempool_update(data["params"])

self.metrics['api_calls']['quicknode'] += 1

except Exception as e:
self.metrics['errors']['parse'] += 1
logger.error(f"QuickNode message error: {e}")

async def _handle_market_update(self, update: Dict):
"""Process market data update"""
try:
# Update price
if "lastPrice" in update:
price = Decimal(str(update["lastPrice"]))
volume = Decimal(str(update.get("volume24h", 0)))

self.scalp_state = ScalpState(
current_price=price,
bid_price=Decimal(str(update.get("bestBid", price))),
ask_price=Decimal(str(update.get("bestAsk", price))),
buyer_volume=volume * Decimal(str(update.get("buyVolume", 0))),
seller_volume=volume * Decimal(str(update.get("sellVolume", 0))),
timestamp=time.time()
)

# Update price history
self.price_history.append((float(price), float(volume), time.time()))

# Check for scalping opportunity
if await self._should_scalp():
await self._execute_scalp()

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Market update error: {e}")

@torch.jit.script
def calculate_scalp_signals(self, prices: torch.Tensor, volumes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
"""Calculate scalping signals with JIT"""
short_mom = (prices[-1] - prices[-10]) / prices[-10]
med_mom = (prices[-1] - prices[-50]) / prices[-50]

volume_weight = volumes / torch.sum(volumes)
vwap = torch.sum(prices * volume_weight)
price_to_vwap = (prices[-1] - vwap) / vwap

return torch.stack([short_mom, med_mom, price_to_vwap])

async def _should_scalp(self) -> bool:
"""Check if we should enter a scalp trade"""
try:
if not self.scalp_state or len(self.active_scalps) >= self.SCALP_CONFIG['max_active_scalps']:
return False

with torch.cuda.stream(self.streams['scalp']):
prices = torch.tensor([p[0] for p in self.price_history], device=self.device)
volumes = torch.tensor([p[1] for p in self.price_history], device=self.device)

signals = self.calculate_scalp_signals(prices, volumes)
short_mom, med_mom, price_to_vwap = signals

# Long entry
if (short_mom > 0.002 and med_mom > 0.005 and price_to_vwap < -0.002):
self.scalp_state.side = 'buy'
return True

# Short entry
if (short_mom < -0.002 and med_mom < -0.005 and price_to_vwap > 0.002):
self.scalp_state.side = 'sell'
return True

return False

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Scalp check error: {e}")
return False

async def _execute_scalp(self):
"""Execute scalp trade"""
try:
if not await self._check_rate_limits(trade=True):
return

size = self.SCALP_CONFIG['position_size']
entry_price = float(self.scalp_state.current_price)

params = TradeParams(
pool_address=os.getenv('SOL_WSOL_AMM_ID'),
amount_in=size,
min_amount_out=0,
wsol_account=self.wsol_account
)

signature = await self.trading_core.execute_trade(params)
if signature:
self.active_scalps.append({
'entry_price': entry_price,
'size': size,
'side': self.scalp_state.side,
'target': entry_price * (1 + self.SCALP_CONFIG['min_profit_pct']),
'stop': entry_price * (1 - self.SCALP_CONFIG['max_loss_pct']),
'entry_time': time.time()
})

self.metrics['scalp_trades'] += 1
logger.info(f"Entered {self.scalp_state.side} scalp at {entry_price}")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Scalp execution error: {e}")

async def _monitor_active_scalps(self):
"""Monitor and manage active scalp positions"""
while self.active:
try:
if not self.scalp_state:
await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
continue

price = float(self.scalp_state.current_price)

for scalp in self.active_scalps[:]:
# Check exit conditions
if ((scalp['side'] == 'buy' and price >= scalp['target']) or
(scalp['side'] == 'sell' and price <= scalp['target']) or
(scalp['side'] == 'buy' and price <= scalp['stop']) or
(scalp['side'] == 'sell' and price >= scalp['stop'])):

await self._close_scalp(scalp)

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Scalp monitoring error: {e}")

await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

async def _close_scalp(self, scalp: Dict):
"""Close scalp position"""
try:
params = TradeParams(
pool_address=os.getenv('SOL_WSOL_AMM_ID'),
amount_in=scalp['size'],
min_amount_out=0,
wsol_account=self.wsol_account
)

signature = await self.trading_core.execute_trade(params)
if signature:
exit_price = float(self.scalp_state.current_price)
pnl = (exit_price - scalp['entry_price']) * scalp['size']

self.metrics['scalp_profit'] += Decimal(str(pnl))
self.active_scalps.remove(scalp)

logger.info(f"Closed scalp position, PnL: {pnl}")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Scalp close error: {e}")

async def cleanup(self):
"""
Cleanup resources and gracefully shut down the client
Closes websocket connections, thread pools, and logs final metrics
"""
try:
# Set active flag to false to stop background tasks
self.active = False

# Close websocket connections
if self.ws_helius:
await self.ws_helius.close()
if self.ws_quicknode:
await self.ws_quicknode.close()

# Close aiohttp session if exists
if self.session:
await self.session.close()

# Shutdown thread pool
if self.thread_pool:
self.thread_pool.shutdown(wait=True)

# Log final metrics
logger.info("Final Metrics:", extra={
'messages_processed': self.metrics['messages_processed'],
'opportunities_found': self.metrics['opportunities_found'],
'trades_executed': self.metrics['trades_executed'],
'scalp_trades': self.metrics['scalp_trades'],
'total_scalp_profit': self.metrics['scalp_profit'],
'total_mev_profit': self.metrics['mev_profit']
})

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Error during cleanup: {e}")
finally:
# Clear GPU resources if available
if torch.cuda.is_available():
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

async def _monitor_connections(self):
"""
Monitor websocket connection health and reconnect if necessary
"""
while self.active:
try:
# Check last message time
current_time = time.time()
if current_time - self.last_message_time > 60: # 1-minute timeout
logger.warning("No messages received. Reconnecting...")
await self.cleanup()
await self.start()

# Check error metrics
if (self.metrics['errors']['ws'] > 10 or
self.metrics['errors']['parse'] > 50):
logger.error("Excessive errors detected. Resetting connections.")
await self.cleanup()
await self.start()

await asyncio.sleep(30) # Check every 30 seconds

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Connection monitoring error: {e}")
await asyncio.sleep(5)

async def _monitor_performance(self):
"""
Periodic performance monitoring and garbage collection
"""
while self.active:
try:
# Garbage collection
current_time = time.time()
if current_time - self.metrics['last_gc'] > 300: # Every 5 minutes
gc.collect()
self.metrics['last_gc'] = current_time

# Clear old opportunities
while len(self.recent_opportunities) > 1000:
self.recent_opportunities.popleft()

# Log performance metrics
logger.info("Performance Metrics", extra={
'active_scalps': len(self.active_scalps),
'validated_pools': len(self.validated_pools),
'message_rate': self.metrics['messages_processed'] / 300, # per 5 minutes
'trade_success_rate': (self.metrics['trades_executed'] /
max(1, self.metrics['trades_executed'] + self.metrics['failed_trades'])) * 100
})

await asyncio.sleep(300) # Every 5 minutes

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Performance monitoring error: {e}")
await asyncio.sleep(60)

# Optional: Add a method to reset metrics
def reset_metrics(self):
"""
Reset all tracked metrics to initial state
"""
self.metrics = {
'messages_processed': 0,
'opportunities_found': 0,
'trades_executed': 0,
'failed_trades': 0,
'api_calls': {'helius': 0, 'quicknode': 0},
'errors': {'ws': 0, 'parse': 0, 'execution': 0},
'latency': [],
'last_gc': time.time(),
'scalp_trades': 0,
'scalp_profit': Decimal('0'),
'mev_profit': Decimal('0')
}
logger.info("Metrics have been reset")

# Additional method to check rate limits before critical actions
async def _check_rate_limits(self, trade: bool = False) -> bool:
"""

import asyncio

from typing import Optional, List

import logging

# Import core components
from system_manager import SystemManager
from helius_client import HeliusWbSocketClient

from mempool_analyzer import EnhancedMempoolAnalyzer

from gpu_accelerator import GPUAccelerator, AcceleratorConfig
from vector_store import EnhancedVectorStore
from raydium_parser import RaydiumParser
from price_impact import PriceImpactCalculator

from solana_logger import SolanaLogger, log_info, log_error, log_debug

# Initialize logger
logger = SolanaLogger(__name__)

# Set Windows event loop policy
if sys.platform == 'win32':
asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy())

@asynccontextmanager
async def managed_client_session(**kwargs):
"""Context manager for aiohttp ClientSession"""
async with aiohttp.ClientSession(**kwargs) as session:
yield session

class TradingSystem:
def __init__(self):
"""Initialize trading system with enhanced monitoring"""
try:
logger.info("Starting trading system initialization")
self.initialized = False
self.is_shutting_down = False
self.exit_stack = AsyncExitStack()
self.sessions = []
self.cleanup_tasks = []
self.system_tasks = set()
self.ws_client = HeliusWbSocketClient(self.trading_core, self.mempool_analyzer)
# Initialize thread pool
self.thread_pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)

# Initialize monitors
self.initialized_components = set()
self.component_health = {}
self.last_health_check = 0

# Initialize performance metrics
self.metrics = {
'initialization_time': 0,
'uptime': 0,
'component_stats': {},
'error_counts': {},
'memory_usage': {}
}

# Initialize component placeholders
self._init_component_placeholders()

logger.info("Trading system base initialization complete")
except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Trading system initialization failed: {str(e)}")
raise

def _init_component_placeholders(self):
"""Initialize component placeholders"""
self.system_manager = None
self.trading_core = None
self.gpu_accelerator = None
self.vector_store = None
self.price_monitor = None
self.ws_client = None
self.advanced_mev_trading = None
self.mempool_analyzer = None
self.solana_cli = None
self.trade_executor = None
self.impact_calculator = None

async def __aenter__(self):
"""Async context manager entry with error handling"""
await self.initialize()
return self

async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
"""Async context manager exit with graceful shutdown"""
await self.shutdown()

async def create_session(self, **kwargs) -> aiohttp.ClientSession:
"""Create and track a new client session"""
async with managed_client_session(**kwargs) as session:
self.sessions.append(session)
return session

async def initialize(self):
"""Comprehensive system initialization with dependency tracking"""
try:
init_start = time.time()
logger.info("Starting trading system initialization")

# Load environment variables
if not await self._load_environment():
raise ValueError("Failed to load environment configuration")

# Initialize components sequentially with dependency tracking
await self._setup_device()
await self._initialize_trading_core()
await self._initialize_gpu_accelerator()
await self._initialize_core_components()
await self._initialize_advanced_components()

self.initialization_time = time.time() - init_start
self.metrics['initialization_time'] = self.initialization_time
self.initialized = True

logger.info("Trading system initialization completed", extra={
'initialization_time': f"{self.initialization_time:.2f}s",
'initialized_components': list(self.initialized_components)
})

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"System initialization failed: {str(e)}")
await self.shutdown()
raise

async def _load_environment(self) -> bool:
"""Load and validate environment configuration"""
try:
logger.debug("Loading environment variables")
load_dotenv(override=True)

# Validate required variables
required_vars = {
'SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY': os.getenv('SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY'),
'HELIUS_WS_URL': os.getenv('HELIUS_WS_URL'),
'RAYDIUM_PROGRAM_ID': os.getenv('RAYDIUM_PROGRAM_ID'),
'WSOL_TOKEN_ACCOUNT': os.getenv('WSOL_TOKEN_ACCOUNT'),
'RPC_URL': os.getenv('RPC_URL'),
'HELIUS_API_KEY': os.getenv('HELIUS_API_KEY')
}

missing = [k for k, v in required_vars.items() if not v]
if missing:
logger.error("Missing required environment variables", extra={
'missing_vars': missing
})
return False

return True

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Environment loading error: {str(e)}")
return False

async def _setup_device(self):
"""Setup compute device with optimizations"""
try:
logger.debug("Setting up compute device")
if torch.cuda.is_available():
self.device = torch.device("cuda")
torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True
torch.cuda.set_device(0)

device_props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0)
logger.info("GPU initialized successfully", extra={
'device': torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
'memory': device_props.total_memory,
'compute_capability': device_props.major
})
else:
self.device = torch.device("cpu")
logger.warning("No GPU available, using CPU")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Device setup failed: {str(e)}")
raise

async def _initialize_trading_core(self):
"""Initialize trading core with enhanced validation"""
try:
logger.debug("Initializing trading core")

# Get and decode private key
private_key_str = os.environ.get('SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY')
if not private_key_str:
raise ValueError("SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY not found in environment")

key_bytes = base58.b58decode(private_key_str)

# Initialize trading core with optimized configuration
self.trading_core = TradingCore(key_bytes)

# Configure trading parameters
trade_config = TradeConfig()
trade_config.compute_limit = int(os.getenv('COMPUTE_LIMIT', '400000'))
trade_config.priority_fee = int(os.getenv('PRIORITY_FEE', '500000'))
trade_config.max_retries = int(os.getenv('MAX_RETRIES', '3'))

# Call update_config directly (not awaited)
self.trading_core.update_config(trade_config)

self.initialized_components.add('trading_core')

logger.info("Trading core initialized successfully")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Trading core initialization failed: {str(e)}")
raise
async def _initialize_gpu_accelerator(self):
"""Initialize GPU Accelerator with proper async handling"""
try:
logger.debug("Initializing GPU Accelerator")

# Create accelerator config
accelerator_config = AcceleratorConfig(
memory_fraction=float(os.getenv('GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION', '0.8')),
batch_size=int(os.getenv('GPU_BATCH_SIZE', '32')),
use_amp=os.getenv('USE_AMP', 'true').lower() == 'true',
use_tensor_cores=os.getenv('GPU_USE_TENSOR_CORES', 'true').lower() == 'true'
)

# Initialize accelerator
self.gpu_accelerator = GPUAccelerator(accelerator_config)

# Add to exit stack for proper cleanup
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.gpu_accelerator)
self.initialized_components.add('gpu_accelerator')

logger.info("GPU Accelerator initialized successfully")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"GPU Accelerator initialization failed: {str(e)}")
raise

async def _initialize_core_components(self):
"""Initialize core system components with dependency tracking"""
try:
logger.debug("Initializing core components")

# Initialize system manager
self.system_manager = SystemManager()
await self.system_manager.start()
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.system_manager)

# Initialize vector store
self.vector_store = EnhancedVectorStore()
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.vector_store)

# Initialize Solana CLI
self.solana_cli = SolanaCLI(self.trading_core)
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.solana_cli)

# Initialize trade executor
self.trade_executor = TradeExecutor(self.trading_core)
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.trade_executor)

# Initialize other core components
self.impact_calculator = PriceImpactCalculator()
self.raydium_parser = RaydiumParser()
self.optimized_parser = EnhancedParser()

# Update initialized components
self.initialized_components.update({
'system_manager',
'vector_store',
'solana_cli',
'trade_executor',
'impact_calculator'
})

logger.info("Core components initialized successfully")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Core components initialization failed: {str(e)}")
raise

async def _initialize_advanced_components(self):
"""Initialize advanced trading components with optimized networking"""
try:
logger.debug("Initializing advanced components")

# Create optimized network session
connector = aiohttp.TCPConnector(
family=socket.AF_INET,
ssl=False,
force_close=True,
enable_cleanup_closed=True
)
session = await self.create_session(connector=connector)

# Initialize components with proper dependency injection
self.mempool_analyzer = EnhancedMempoolAnalyzer(self.trading_core)
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.mempool_analyzer)

self.advanced_mev_trading = AdvancedMEVTrading(
trading_core=self.trading_core,
session=session
)
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.advanced_mev_trading)

self.price_monitor = RaydiumMonitor()
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.price_monitor)

self.ws_client = HeliusWbSocketClient(
trading_core=self.trading_core,
mempool_analyzer=self.mempool_analyzer
)
await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(self.ws_client)

# Update initialized components
self.initialized_components.update({
'mempool_analyzer',
'advanced_mev_trading',
'price_monitor',
'ws_client'
})

logger.info("Advanced components initialized successfully")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Advanced components initialization failed: {str(e)}")
raise

async def start(self):
"""Start all system components with health monitoring"""
if not self.initialized:
await self.initialize()

try:
logger.info("Starting system components")

# Start core services
await self.solana_cli.start()
await self.price_monitor.start_monitoring()
await self.ws_client.start()
await self.advanced_mev_trading.start()
await self.vector_store.start()

# Start monitoring
monitor_task = asyncio.create_task(
self._monitor_system_health(),
name="health_monitor"
)
self.system_tasks.add(monitor_task)

logger.info("All components started successfully")

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"System startup failed: {str(e)}")
await self.shutdown()
raise

async def _monitor_system_health(self):
"""Monitor system health with comprehensive metrics"""
while not self.is_shutting_down:
try:
# Check component health
for component in self.initialized_components:
if hasattr(self, component):
component_obj = getattr(self, component)
if hasattr(component_obj, 'get_health'):
health = await component_obj.get_health()
self.component_health[component] = health

# Update system metrics
self.metrics.update({
'uptime': time.time() - self.metrics['initialization_time'],
'component_stats': self.component_health,
'memory_usage': {
'system': psutil.Process().memory_info().rss / 1024**2,
'gpu': torch.cuda.memory_allocated() / 1024**2
if torch.cuda.is_available() else 0
}
})

# Log metrics periodically
if int(time.time()) % 300 == 0: # Every 5 minutes
logger.info("System health metrics", extra={
'metrics': self.metrics
})

await asyncio.sleep(1)

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Health monitoring error: {str(e)}")
await asyncio.sleep(5)

async def shutdown(self):
"""Comprehensive system shutdown and cleanup"""
if self.is_shutting_down:
return

self.is_shutting_down = True
logger.info("Initiating system shutdown")

try:
# Cancel system tasks
for task in self.system_tasks:
task.cancel()
try:
await task
except asyncio.CancelledError:
pass

# Close exit stack (handles component cleanup)
await self.exit_stack.aclose()

# Shutdown thread pool
self.thread_pool.shutdown(wait=True)

# Log final metrics
logger.info("System shutdown complete", extra={
'final_metrics': self.metrics,
'uptime': time.time() - self.metrics['initialization_time'],
'initialized_components': list(self.initialized_components)
})

# Clear component references
self._clear_components()

except Exception as e:
logger.error(f"Error during shutdown: {str(e)}")
finally:
self.initialized = False
self.is_shutting_down = False

def _clear_components(self):
"""Clear all component references"""
self.system_manager = None
self.trading_core = None
self.gpu_accelerator = None
self.vector_store = None
self.price_monitor = None
self.ws_client = None
self.advanced_mev_trading = None
self.mempool_analyzer = None
self.solana_cli = None
self.trade_executor = None
self.impact_calculator = None

async def main():
"""Main entry point with comprehensive error handling"""
trading_system = None

try:
# Setup initial logging
log_dir = Path("logs")
log_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

log_info("Starting Solana trading system")

# System information
log_debug(f"Python version: {sys.version}")
log_debug(f"Current directory: {os.getcwd()}")
log_debug(f"PYTHONPATH: {os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', 'Not set')}")

# Initialize trading system
log_info("Initializing trading system...")
trading_system = TradingSystem()

async with trading_system:
log_info("Trading system initialized, starting components...")
await trading_system.start()

# Create event to handle shutdown
shutdown_event = asyncio.Event()

def signal_handler():
log_info("Shutdown signal received")
shutdown_event.set()

# Register signal handlers
for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
loop.add_signal_handler(sig, signal_handler)

log_info("Trading system running, waiting for signals...")
# Wait for shutdown signal
await shutdown_event.wait()

except KeyboardInterrupt:
log_info("Graceful shutdown initiated")
except Exception as e:
log_error(f"Critical system error: {str(e)}")
finally:
if trading_system and trading_system.initialized:
log_info("Shutting down trading system...")
try:
await trading_system.shutdown()
log_info("Shutdown complete")
except Exception as e:
log_error(f"Error during final cleanup: {str(e)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
try:
# Configure event loop for Windows
if sys.platform == 'win32':
asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy())

# Create event loop
loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)

# Set debug if configured
if os.getenv('DEBUG', 'false').lower() == 'true':
loop.set_debug(True)
logging.getLogger('asyncio').setLevel(logging.DEBUG)

# Run main
try:
loop.run_until_complete(main())
except KeyboardInterrupt:
pass
finally:
try:
# Clean up pending tasks
pending = asyncio.all_tasks(loop)
if pending:
loop.run_until_complete(asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True))
finally:
loop.close()

8357_1.text: I am building a 3d renderer in C++ using Vulkan.hpp. I am in the process of implementing a SSAO stage into the rendering pipeline, but I am running into some issues. The output of the shader is a black image. After extensive debugging, I believe I have narrowed down the issue to the sampling, offset or rangecheck components of the shader. There is some occlusion being created by the shader, but it is very minor. It is more visible on very close objects, but not noticeable at all on even medium distance objects. I do wonder whether the range check is working correctly or whether it need to be adjusted by the nearPlane and farPlane values. The shader takes in a depth buffer and reconstructs the position information using this buffer. This means the shader needs to manage different projections and the near and far planes of the projection. I don't believe there are any issues with this, but it is worth noting for reference.

package main

import (
"bufio"
"fmt"
"math/rand"
"os"
"strconv"
"strings"
"time"
)

const filename = "CharacterData.txt" // The file where Character data will be stored

func main() { // Create a variable to capture user pressing Enter
rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano()) // Seed rand with the current time
var input string
fmt.Println("Press Enter to generate a random NPC...")
for { // Infinite loop allowing repeated NPC generation
fmt.Scanln(&input) // Wait for user to press Enter
npc := generateNPC() // Generate and output the NPC
npcOutput := formatOutput(npc)
fmt.Println("Generated NPC Output:", npcOutput)
appendToFile(npcOutput) // Append the NPC output to the text file
}
}

func getNextID() int { // Function to read existing data from the file and find the next ID
file, err := os.Open(filename)
if err != nil {
return 1 // If the file doesn't exist, return ID 1
}
defer file.Close()
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
maxID := 0
for scanner.Scan() {
line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text()) // Trim the line for any whitespace
if line == "" { // Skip empty lines
continue
}
parts := strings.Split(line, ",") // Split by commas
if len(parts) > 0 {
idStr := strings.Trim(parts[0], "[c/") // Assuming IDs start with "[c/" prefix
idStr = strings.Trim(idStr, "]") // Trim the closing bracket
id, err := strconv.Atoi(idStr) // Parse the ID
if err == nil && id > maxID {
maxID = id
} else if err != nil {
fmt.Printf("Error parsing ID from line "%s": %v
", line, err)
}
}
}
if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
fmt.Println("Error reading from file:", err)
}
return maxID + 1 // Next ID is maxID + 1
}

func generateNPC() []int { // Function to generate a random NPC
playerID := getNextID() // Get the next sequential NPC ID
var firstsexgene1, firstsexgene2, secondsexgene1, secondsexgene2 int // Loop to regenerate NPC until valid
for { // Generate gender genes
firstsexgene1 = rand.Intn(2) + 1 // Gender selection logic, firstsexgene1 can be 1 or 2
firstsexgene2 = rand.Intn(2) + 1 // Gender selection logic, firstsexgene2 can be 1 or 2
secondsexgene1 = rand.Intn(3) + 1 // Gender selection logic, secondsexgene1 can be 1, 2, or 3
secondsexgene2 = rand.Intn(3) + 1 // Gender selection logic, secondsexgene2 can be 1, 2, or 3
if !(firstsexgene1 == 2 && firstsexgene2 == 2) { // Check the condition to see if NPC is valid
break // If valid, exit the loop
}
}
gender := []int{firstsexgene1, firstsexgene2, secondsexgene1, secondsexgene2} // Create the gender slice using all gender genes
skinColors := []int{ // Random skin colors (RGB between 0-255)
rand.Intn(57) + 200, // R between 200 and 255 (inclusive)
rand.Intn(77) + 150, // G between 150 and 226 (inclusive)
rand.Intn(81) + 120, // B between 120 and 200 (inclusive)
}
eyeColors := []int{ // Random eye colors (RGB between 0-255)
rand.Intn(256), // R between 0 and 255 (inclusive)
rand.Intn(256), // G between 0 and 255 (inclusive)
rand.Intn(256), // B between 0 and 255 (inclusive)
}
faceshape := rand.Intn(10) + 1 // Faceshape variation (should be between 1 and 10)
browshape := rand.Intn(10) + 1 // Browshape variation (should be between 1 and 10)
eyeshape := rand.Intn(10) + 1 // Eyeshape variation (should be between 1 and 10)
earshape := rand.Intn(10) + 1 // Earshape variation (should be between 1 and 10)
noseshape := rand.Intn(10) + 1 // Noseshape variation (should be between 1 and 10)
mouthshape := rand.Intn(10) + 1 // Mouthshape variation (should be between 1 and 10)
output := []int{playerID} // Combine created NPC attributes into a single slice
output = append(output, gender...) // Append gender data to output
output = append(output, skinColors...) // Append skin color data
output = append(output, eyeColors...) // Append eye color data
output = append(output, faceshape) // Append faceshape to output
output = append(output, browshape) // Append browshape to output
output = append(output, eyeshape) // Append eyeshape to output
output = append(output, earshape) // Append earshape to output
output = append(output, noseshape) // Append noseshape to output
output = append(output, mouthshape) // Append mouthshape to output
return output
}

func intSliceToStringSlice(ints []int) []string { // Function to convert []int to []string
strSlice := make([]string, len(ints))
for i, v := range ints {
strSlice[i] = fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
}
return strSlice
}

func formatOutput(output []int) string { // Function to format output as expected
stringOutput := intSliceToStringSlice(output)
return fmt.Sprintf("[c/%s]", strings.Join(stringOutput, ","))

class AimAssistThread(QtCore.QThread):
    aim_active_signal = QtCore.pyqtSignal(bool)

    def __init__(self, settings, get_targets_func, get_fov_center_func):
        super().__init__()
        self.settings = settings
        self.get_targets = get_targets_func
        self.get_fov_center = get_fov_center_func
        self.running = False
        self.aim_active = False
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        
        # Tracking settings
        self.locked_track_id = None
        self.target_acquired = False
        
        # Performance settings
        self.aim_fps = 1000  # Increased for faster response
        self.frame_time = 1.0 / self.aim_fps
        self.last_aim_time = 0
        
        # Anti-recoil settings
        self.recoil_control = True
        self.recoil_strength = 1.3  # Adjust as needed
        self.recoil_recovery = 0.90  # Recovery rate
        self.current_recoil = 0
        
        # Aim settings
        self.aim_smoothing = 0.73  # Lower = faster aim
        self.max_speed = 8  # Increased max speed
        self.deadzone = 1.0  # Reduced deadzone
        
        # Toggle controls
        self.toggle_key = 'p'
        self.aim_toggled_on = False
        self.last_toggle_time = 0
        self.toggle_cooldown = 0.15  # Faster toggle response

    def calculate_aim_point(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        """Fast aim point calculation with height-based targeting"""
        center_x = (x1 + x2) >> 1
        height = y2 - y1
        # Aim higher for distant targets (smaller height)
        aim_height = 0.2 if height < 100 else 0.3
        center_y = y1 + int(height * aim_height)  # Aim at upper chest/head
        return center_x, center_y

    def apply_anti_recoil(self, dy):
        """Apply dynamic anti-recoil compensation"""
        if not self.recoil_control:
            return dy
            
        if dy > 0:  # Only apply when aiming down
            self.current_recoil = min(self.current_recoil + 0.2, self.recoil_strength)
        else:
            self.current_recoil *= self.recoil_recovery
            
        return dy - (self.current_recoil * 2.0)

    def calculate_movement(self, target_pos, fc_x, fc_y):
        """Optimized movement calculation with anti-recoil"""
        if not target_pos:
            return 0, 0

        dx = target_pos[0] - fc_x
        dy = target_pos[1] - fc_y
        
        # Apply deadzone
        if abs(dx) <= self.deadzone and abs(dy) <= self.deadzone:
            return 0, 0

        # Calculate base movement
        move_x = dx * self.aim_smoothing
        move_y = dy * self.aim_smoothing
        
        # Apply anti-recoil to vertical movement
        move_y = self.apply_anti_recoil(move_y)
        
        # Speed limiting
        move_x = clamp(move_x, -self.max_speed, self.max_speed)
        move_y = clamp(move_y, -self.max_speed, self.max_speed)

        return int(move_x), int(move_y)

    def get_best_target(self, targets, fc_x, fc_y, fov_radius):
        """Fast target selection with priority system"""
        if not targets:
            return None, None
            
        best_target = None
        best_score = float('inf')
        fov_radius_sq = fov_radius * fov_radius
        
        for target in targets:
            if len(target) < 4:
                continue
                
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = target[:4]
            track_id = target[5] if len(target) > 5 else None
            
            # Fast center calculation
            center_x, center_y = self.calculate_aim_point(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            
            # Quick distance check
            dx = center_x - fc_x
            dy = center_y - fc_y
            dist_sq = dx*dx + dy*dy
            
            if dist_sq >= fov_radius_sq:
                continue
                
            # Prioritize current target
            if track_id == self.locked_track_id:
                return (center_x, center_y), target
                
            # Score based on distance and size
            target_size = (x2-x1) * (y2-y1)
            score = dist_sq / (target_size + 1)
            
            if score < best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_target = ((center_x, center_y), target)
                
        return best_target if best_target else (None, None)

    def run(self):
        """High-performance aim assist loop"""
        self.running = True
        sleep_time = 0.0001  # Minimal sleep
        
        while self.running:
            try:
                current_time = time.perf_counter()
                
                if current_time - self.last_aim_time < self.frame_time:
                    time.sleep(sleep_time)
                    continue

                self.last_aim_time = current_time

                # Fast toggle check
                if keyboard.is_pressed(self.toggle_key):
                    if current_time - self.last_toggle_time > self.toggle_cooldown:
                        self.aim_toggled_on = not self.aim_toggled_on
                        self.last_toggle_time = current_time

                aim_active = False

                if self.aim_toggled_on and self.settings.get('aim_enabled', True):
                    with self.lock:
                        targets = self.get_targets()

                    fov_center = self.get_fov_center()
                    
                    if targets and fov_center:
                        fc_x, fc_y = (fov_center.x(), fov_center.y()) if hasattr(fov_center, "x") else fov_center
                        fov_radius = self.settings.get('fov_radius', 200)
                        
                        target_pos, target_data = self.get_best_target(targets, fc_x, fc_y, fov_radius)
                        
                        if target_pos:
                            if not self.target_acquired:
                                self.target_acquired = True
                                if target_data and len(target_data) > 5:
                                    self.locked_track_id = target_data[5]
                            
                            mdx, mdy = self.calculate_movement(target_pos, fc_x, fc_y)
                            
                            if mdx != 0 or mdy != 0:
                                move_mouse_relative(mdx, mdy)
                                aim_active = True
                        else:
                            self.target_acquired = False
                            self.locked_track_id = None
                            self.current_recoil = 0
                
                if aim_active != self.aim_active:
                    self.aim_active = aim_active
                    self.aim_active_signal.emit(self.aim_active)

            except Exception as e:
                logging.error(f"AimAssist error: {e}")
                time.sleep(sleep_time)

    def stop(self):
        """Clean shutdown"""
        self.running = False
        self.target_acquired = False
        self.locked_track_id = None
        self.current_recoil = 0

"""Setup DirectML for maximum AMD GPU performance with fallbacks"""
try:
# Try DirectML first
if torch_directml.is_available():
device_count = torch_directml.device_count()
logging.info(f"DirectML available with {device_count} device(s)")

torch.backends.directml.allow_reduced_precision = True

logging.info(f"DirectML device initialized: {dml_device}")
return dml_device

# Fallback to CUDA if available
if torch.cuda.is_available():
cuda_device = torch.device('cuda:0')
logging.info(f"CUDA device initialized: {cuda_device}")
return cuda_device

# Final fallback to CPU with warning
logging.warning("No GPU available, falling back to CPU (performance will be reduced)")
return torch.device('cpu')

except Exception as e:
logging.warning(f"GPU setup failed ({e}), falling back to CPU")
return torch.device('cpu')

def _load_models(self, models_config):
"""Load models with DirectML optimization for maximum performance"""
for model_path, imgsz in models_config:
try:
# Load YOLO model
model = YOLO(model_path)

# Force model to DirectML device for 100% GPU utilization
model.model = model.model.to(self.device)

# Set model to evaluation mode and optimize
model.model.eval()

# Enable DirectML optimizations
if hasattr(torch.backends, 'directml') and torch.backends.directml.enabled:
# Compile model for maximum DirectML performance
try:
model.model = torch.jit.optimize_for_inference(model.model)
logging.info(f"Model JIT optimized for DirectML: {model_path}")
except:
logging.info(f"JIT optimization skipped for: {model_path}")

# Zero-latency warmup with DirectML - more aggressive
dummy = torch.zeros((1, 3, imgsz, imgsz), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)

with torch.no_grad():
# More aggressive warmup - 15 iterations for maximum DirectML optimization
for _ in range(15):
try:
_ = model.model(dummy)
except:
# Fallback warmup using predict
dummy_np = np.zeros((imgsz, imgsz, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
model.predict(
source=dummy_np,
imgsz=imgsz,
device=self.device,
verbose=False,
stream=False
)
break

# Clear cache for maximum performance (if DirectML available)
if hasattr(torch, 'directml') and str(self.device).startswith('privateuseone'):
torch.directml.empty_cache()
elif torch.cuda.is_available() and self.device.type == 'cuda':
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

self.models.append((model, imgsz))

all_results = []
original_height, original_width = frame.shape[:2]

scale_y = original_height / imgsz

source=resized_frame,
save=False,
imgsz=imgsz,
conf=conf_thres,

continue

# No cache clearing to maintain maximum GPU utilization

if hasattr(torch, 'directml') and str(self.device).startswith('privateuseone'):
pass # Keep DirectML memory allocated

crop_width = min(fov_radius * 2, self.screen_width - crop_x)
crop_height = min(fov_radius * 2, self.screen_height - crop_y)

if crop_width < 100 or crop_height < 100:
continue

# Capture screen region using BitBlt
frame = self.capture_screen_region(crop_x, crop_y, crop_width, crop_height)

if frame is None or frame.size == 0:
continue

# Convert color space
frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGRA2RGB)

# Run detection with DirectML on single model only for speed
conf_thres = clamp(self.settings.get('confidence', 0.3), 0.2, 0.5) # lower to skip low confidence

with torch.no_grad():
# Resize frame only once, no scaling jitter
resized_frame = cv2.resize(frame, (main_imgsz, main_imgsz), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)

results = main_model.predict(
source=resized_frame,
save=False,
imgsz=main_imgsz,
conf=conf_thres,
iou=0.3, # Slightly relaxed IOU for speed
device=self.yolo_ensemble.device,
half=False,
verbose=False,
stream=False,
agnostic_nms=True,
max_det=20, # lower max detection to reduce compute
classes=[0], # Only person class
retina_masks=False
)[0]

# Process detections
detections = []
if hasattr(results, 'boxes') and len(results.boxes) > 0:
boxes = results.boxes.xyxy.cpu().numpy()
confs = results.boxes.conf.cpu().numpy()
classes = results.boxes.cls.cpu().numpy()

scale_x = crop_width / main_imgsz
scale_y = crop_height / main_imgsz

# Convert to screen space coordinates
transformed_boxes = []
for box in boxes:
x1, y1, x2, y2 = box
x1_screen = int(x1 * scale_x + crop_x)
y1_screen = int(y1 * scale_y + crop_y)
x2_screen = int(x2 * scale_x + crop_x)
y2_screen = int(y2 * scale_y + crop_y)
transformed_boxes.append((x1_screen, y1_screen, x2_screen, y2_screen))

for (x1_screen, y1_screen, x2_screen, y2_screen), conf, cls in zip(transformed_boxes, confs, classes):
if conf < conf_thres:
continue
# Basic bounds check
if (x1_screen < x2_screen and y1_screen < y2_screen and
x1_screen >= 0 and y1_screen >= 0 and
x2_screen <= self.screen_width and y2_screen <= self.screen_height):
detections.append((x1_screen, y1_screen, x2_screen, y2_screen, float(conf), "person"))

# Sort detections by confidence (highest first)
detections.sort(key=lambda x: x[4], reverse=True)

# Emit detection signal with empty tracking info (no tracker)
boxes = [(x1, y1, x2, y2) for (x1, y1, x2, y2, conf, label) in detections]
confidences = [conf for (_, _, _, _, conf, _) in detections]
labels = [label for (_, _, _, _, _, label) in detections]

# Emit with empty track IDs and repeated labels as tracking is disabled
self.detection_signal.emit(boxes, labels, confidences, labels, [0]*len(boxes))

except Exception as e:
logging.error(f"Detection error: {e}")

finally:
self.cleanup_bitblt()

def stop(self):
"""Clean shutdown"""
self.running = False
self.cleanup_bitblt()
logging.info("BitBlt detection stopped")




class AimAssistThread(QtCore.QThread):
aim_active_signal = QtCore.pyqtSignal(bool)

def __init__(self, settings, get_targets_func, get_fov_center_func):
super().__init__()
self.settings = settings
self.get_targets = get_targets_func
self.get_fov_center = get_fov_center_func
self.running = False
self.aim_active = False
self.lock = threading.Lock()

# Tracking settings
self.locked_track_id = None
self.target_acquired = False

# Performance settings
self.aim_fps = 1000 # Increased for faster response
self.frame_time = 1.0 / self.aim_fps
self.last_aim_time = 0

# Anti-recoil settings
self.recoil_control = True
self.recoil_strength = 1.2 # Adjust as needed
self.recoil_recovery = 0.95 # Recovery rate
self.current_recoil = 0

# Aim settings
self.aim_smoothing = 0.75 # Lower = faster aim
self.max_speed = 8 # Increased max speed
self.deadzone = 1.5 # Reduced deadzone

# Toggle controls
self.toggle_key = 'p'
self.aim_toggled_on = False
self.last_toggle_time = 0
self.toggle_cooldown = 0.15 # Faster toggle response

def calculate_aim_point(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
"""Fast aim point calculation with height-based targeting"""
center_x = (x1 + x2) >> 1
height = y2 - y1
# Aim higher for distant targets (smaller height)
aim_height = 0.2 if height < 100 else 0.3
center_y = y1 + int(height * aim_height) # Aim at upper chest/head
return center_x, center_y

def apply_anti_recoil(self, dy):
"""Apply dynamic anti-recoil compensation"""
if not self.recoil_control:
return dy

if dy > 0: # Only apply when aiming down
self.current_recoil = min(self.current_recoil + 0.2, self.recoil_strength)
else:
self.current_recoil *= self.recoil_recovery

return dy - (self.current_recoil * 2.0)

def calculate_movement(self, target_pos, fc_x, fc_y):
"""Optimized movement calculation with anti-recoil"""
if not target_pos:
return 0, 0

dx = target_pos[0] - fc_x
dy = target_pos[1] - fc_y

# Apply deadzone
if abs(dx) <= self.deadzone and abs(dy) <= self.deadzone:
return 0, 0

# Calculate base movement
move_x = dx * self.aim_smoothing
move_y = dy * self.aim_smoothing

# Apply anti-recoil to vertical movement
move_y = self.apply_anti_recoil(move_y)

# Speed limiting
move_x = clamp(move_x, -self.max_speed, self.max_speed)
move_y = clamp(move_y, -self.max_speed, self.max_speed)

return int(move_x), int(move_y)

def get_best_target(self, targets, fc_x, fc_y, fov_radius):
"""Fast target selection with priority system"""
if not targets:
return None, None

best_target = None
best_score = float('inf')
fov_radius_sq = fov_radius * fov_radius

for target in targets:
if len(target) < 4:
continue

x1, y1, x2, y2 = target[:4]
track_id = target[5] if len(target) > 5 else None

# Fast center calculation
center_x, center_y = self.calculate_aim_point(x1, y1, x2, y2)

# Quick distance check
dx = center_x - fc_x
dy = center_y - fc_y
dist_sq = dx*dx + dy*dy

if dist_sq >= fov_radius_sq:
continue

# Prioritize current target
if track_id == self.locked_track_id:
return (center_x, center_y), target

# Score based on distance and size
target_size = (x2-x1) * (y2-y1)
score = dist_sq / (target_size + 1)

if score < best_score:
best_score = score
best_target = ((center_x, center_y), target)

return best_target if best_target else (None, None)

def run(self):
"""High-performance aim assist loop"""
self.running = True
sleep_time = 0.0001 # Minimal sleep

while self.running:
try:
current_time = time.perf_counter()

if current_time - self.last_aim_time < self.frame_time:
time.sleep(sleep_time)
continue

self.last_aim_time = current_time

# Fast toggle check
if keyboard.is_pressed(self.toggle_key):
if current_time - self.last_toggle_time > self.toggle_cooldown:
self.aim_toggled_on = not self.aim_toggled_on
self.last_toggle_time = current_time

aim_active = False

if self.aim_toggled_on and self.settings.get('aim_enabled', True):
with self.lock:
targets = self.get_targets()

fov_center = self.get_fov_center()

if targets and fov_center:
fc_x, fc_y = (fov_center.x(), fov_center.y()) if hasattr(fov_center, "x") else fov_center
fov_radius = self.settings.get('fov_radius', 200)

target_pos, target_data = self.get_best_target(targets, fc_x, fc_y, fov_radius)

if target_pos:
if not self.target_acquired:
self.target_acquired = True
if target_data and len(target_data) > 5:
self.locked_track_id = target_data[5]

mdx, mdy = self.calculate_movement(target_pos, fc_x, fc_y)

if mdx != 0 or mdy != 0:
move_mouse_relative(mdx, mdy)
aim_active = True
else:
self.target_acquired = False
self.locked_track_id = None
self.current_recoil = 0

if aim_active != self.aim_active:
self.aim_active = aim_active
self.aim_active_signal.emit(self.aim_active)

except Exception as e:
logging.error(f"AimAssist error: {e}")
time.sleep(sleep_time)

def stop(self):
"""Clean shutdown"""
self.running = False
self.target_acquired = False
self.locked_track_id = None
self.current_recoil = 0
